newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 50,700 MT were primarily the result of increases for Indonesia (30,000 MT), Mexico (11,200 MT), and Italy (10,500 MT) being more than offset by reductions for unknown destinations (59,000 MT) and South Korea (50,000 MT).
Sales of 556,200 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for unknown destinations (296,200 MT) and China (132,000 MT).

Exports of 220,900 MT were off 38 percent from the previous week and one-quarter from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (107,600 MT), Mexico (61,300 MT), and Indonesia (30,000 MT).
